stage.kittenTip: Vaccinations on schedule, parasite treatments, lots of play and sleep.
stage.youngTip: A yearly vet check-up and weight control are the best prevention.
stage.matureTip: Yearly check-ups and attention to teeth and weight: extra pounds matter more now.
stage.seniorTip: Check-ups every six months, blood tests, and attention to kidneys, joints and appetite.
